pieces.title: Followspot
pieces.note: A restless beam hunts the dark. Move your finger — it will find you.

pieces.title: Barrel & Comb
pieces.note: Scratch the wheel like a record — pins pluck a comb and a tiny music box wakes up.

pieces.title: Afterlight
pieces.note: Wherever your eye lands, glows. Wherever it doesn't, the dark quietly takes it back.

pieces.title: Tell
pieces.note: Pick a side, over and over. Around the twentieth time, it stops being a guess.

pieces.title: House Style
pieces.note: Say what you mean. It will say it more nicely for you.

pieces.title: Ration
pieces.note: A small lamp. Feed it however you like — it's keeping track of more than you think.

pieces.title: Hit Your Mark
pieces.note: One instruction. Nobody said which way to get there.

pieces.title: (Beat.)
pieces.note: A single cue lamp. Wait for it — though it may not wait for you.

pieces.title: (Bring the House Down.)
pieces.note: Tap the marquee. Watch the show get brighter and brighter.

pieces.title: Counterweight
pieces.note: A rope, a batten, and a system happy to show you exactly how hard it's pulling back.

pieces.title: (Confirm.)
pieces.note: One button. Tap it whenever you like — it's always right on time.

pieces.title: Downbeat
pieces.note: Tap along. The beat never moves — but being "in time" does.

pieces.title: (Best Available.)
pieces.note: Ask the window for tonight's price. It was made just for you.

pieces.title: Dress Rehearsal
pieces.note: One fader, one spotlight. Nobody has ever told you where the top is.

pieces.title: (Required Notice.)
pieces.note: A brass plaque, fully compliant. Read it under the house lights — there's nothing else to find.

pieces.title: (Prompt.)
pieces.note: A rope, a bell, and a rule about how sure you have to be. The rule keeps changing — it isn't telling you why.

pieces.title: Topping
pieces.note: A spotlight, a rhythm, and a partner who's gotten very good at knowing when you're about to reach for it.

pieces.title: (Leave It for the Next One.)
pieces.note: A corkboard backstage, half in shadow. Somebody's been leaving notes. Read them in whatever order you like.

pieces.title: Upstaged
pieces.note: A lamp, a cue, a partner taking his bow. He swears the applause is for both of you.

pieces.title: (Near Enough.)
pieces.note: Find the one you were sent for. The door only remembers whole minutes at a time.

pieces.title: Understudy
pieces.note: A cleat, a coil of rope, and a partner who only needed to watch you tie it twice.

pieces.title: (Unprecedented.)
pieces.note: Pull the rope, lower whoever's meant to go. The house has never seen this happen before.

pieces.title: Douser
pieces.note: A follow spot, a line marked for professional use only, and a switch that's very easy to hold.

pieces.title: (Positive Control.)
pieces.note: A follow spot, a performer, and a console that's better at this than it lets on.

pieces.title: Fair Hand
pieces.note: A sign-in sheet, one blank line. Pause too long and somebody helps.

pieces.title: (Present.)
pieces.note: A work light, a punch card, and a night that only knows if you moved.

pieces.title: Headroom
pieces.note: A house dimmer, a shared bus, and a rig that only takes what's left open.

pieces.title: (Vital Local Water Resources.)
pieces.note: A cistern backstage, a tap, and a lamp with first claim on all of it. Hold on — somebody upstream already knows how this ends.

pieces.title: Restrung
pieces.note: A marionette on five strings — mend what frays. It never once stops dancing the same dance.

pieces.title: (Advisory Only.)
pieces.note: A hook, a work light, a name that keeps getting replaced. Hold on as long as you like — nobody said what that buys you.

pieces.title: The Iron
pieces.note: A rope backstage, a curtain tested every week. It always falls exactly the same way.

pieces.title: (Already on the Board.)
pieces.note: A punch list under a single bulb. Tap to close what's done — nobody asked who opened it.
